mcp.error.app_open: The MCP App view could not be opened. Check the server connection in Tools.
mcp.error.app_call: The MCP App view could not use that tool. Check the server connection in Tools.
mcp.known.figma.requires: A Figma account with a Dev or Full seat. On the Starter plan the cap is a few calls a month.
mcp.known.figma.after: The first time the agent uses it, Figma will ask you to sign in from the browser.
mcp.known.figma_desktop.requires: Having the Figma desktop app open, with its server enabled in the preferences.
mcp.known.figma_desktop.after: It doesn't ask you to sign in: it uses the session of the app you already have open.
mcp.known.atlassian.requires: Jira and Confluence come with the same connection. Bitbucket doesn't: through this path it asks for an API token instead of the browser session.
mcp.known.atlassian.after: The first time the agent uses it, Atlassian will ask you to sign in. You'll see and be able to do exactly what your account already allows, no more and no less.
mcp.known.excalidraw.requires: Your drawings are stored on Excalidraw's server with no account: anyone with a drawing's ID can open it. It needs an internet connection.
mcp.known.excalidraw.after: Ready as soon as you connect, no sign-in. When the agent draws, the diagram opens in the chat and you can edit it there.
mcp.login.opened_browser: Your browser opened so you can authorize {service}. Come back here when you're done.
mcp.error.catalog_prepare: I couldn't prepare the list of servers.
mcp.error.catalog_save: I couldn't save the list of servers.
mcp.error.not_yours: The person added that server. A task only changes the ones a task added.
mcp.error.name_taken: That server name is already in use or reserved. A task only adds new names.
mcp.error.invalid_name: A server name starts with a letter or a number and only has letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, up to 64 characters.
mcp.error.catalog_unreadable: This workspace's list of servers can't be read, so I left it unchanged. Check mcp.json in the workspace folder.
mcp.error.no_tool_login: {agent} has no separate sign-in for tools.
mcp.error.no_active_account: Connect a {agent} account first — without one, the session you get would have nowhere to be saved.
mcp.error.not_json: That isn't valid JSON. Paste the block exactly as it comes in the server's documentation.
mcp.error.no_servers_in_block: I found no server in that block. It has to be an object, with or without "mcpServers" around it.
mcp.task.title: Some tools need you to sign in
mcp.task.body: The agent can't open the sign-in from the task. Open it here: you authorize in your browser and your next message will have the tools.
mcp.task.next_turn: If you authorized it, your next message uses it, in this same conversation.
mcp.error.login_not_needed: That server has no OAuth sign-in.
